pages.text: The T-Rex, Alosaurus, Baryonyx, and Pointysaurus all yield $(item)Raw Dino Meat$() now — an honest cut from an honest kill, instead of beef that fell out of a lizard.
Furnace, smoker, campfire, or the top of a stove — any heat turns a slab of dino into a $(item)Dino Steak$().

pages.title: Mince It
pages.text: Lay Raw Dino Meat on a $(item)Cutting Board$() and take a $(l:orespawn_delight:the_butcher/tigers_eye_knife)knife$() to it for two portions of $(item)Minced Dino$().$(p)Minced Dino cooks into a $(item)Dino Patty$() over any fire — the foundation of the $(l:orespawn_delight:the_kitchen/burgers_and_sandwiches)Mobzilla Burger$() and the humble Dino Dog alike.
